statement.excerpt: Translation : We will never, ever give you advanced access to red-team any of our software. [Narrator: and they never have.]

from_speaker: to red-team any of our software
our_interpretation: The retrospective assertion concerns access received by Marcus through March 15, 2024.
The rhetorical 'never, ever' is read in context with the retrospective narrator statement, rather than as a separate unlimited forecast.
Advance access means access supplied by OpenAI before general availability for testing the software.
An invitation, ordinary public access or testing through another person's account would not establish that Marcus received the claimed access.
The target period has no specified lower bound because 'never' covers all earlier access, not merely access after the 2020 email.
criteria.support_condition: Sufficiently complete access records or independent, corroborated correspondence establish that Marcus received no advance red-team access to any OpenAI software through the post date.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A dated access record or independently corroborated account establishes at least one qualifying instance before or on March 15, 2024.
